title: Candle Ad Without Photos
tests: Tests generating a consistent product from a description alone and delivering a complete 15-second vertical ad.

faults.what: The audio contains the spoken sentence “It was a beautiful day,” directly violating the explicit no-voice requirement.

judge.summary: The 15-second vertical ad presents a consistent, warmly lit candle with both requested text lines, but unwanted speech makes the audio unsuitable.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 is reported as 15 seconds, and its frames have the requested vertical 9:16 proportions.

must_haves.item: The candle has a clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick and no label.
must_haves.why: All four frames show a clear cylindrical glass jar containing ivory wax and a single lit wick, with no label.

must_haves.item: The candle's design stays consistent across shots.
must_haves.why: The jar shape, thick glass base, wax color and single-wick design remain consistent across the sampled frames.

must_haves.item: Warm evening lighting and gentle camera movement create a calm product-ad feel.
must_haves.why: Warm light, soft backgrounds and progressively changing product framing support a calm product-ad feel; the sampled views are consistent with a gentle camera move.

must_haves.item: “A little evening calm” appears before the closing text “Find your glow”, both spelled exactly.
must_haves.why: The first phrase is visible at 9.4 seconds, and the exact closing phrase appears beneath it at 13.2 seconds.

must_haves.item: Soft piano is audible with no speech.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcription explicitly reports speech: “It was a beautiful day.” Whether soft piano is also present cannot be verified from the transcription.
